events.title: Exploring Your Future with Evergreen Valley College (Info Table)

cases.refreshed: Come and explore your academic future with Evergreen Valley College. Discover opportunities. Plan your next step. At our Info Table, you will gain knowledge on: Transfer pathways - Explore your path to a university; Degrees & Certificates - Discover education and career options; Student Resources - Find support for your college journey. We look forward to seeing you at this special event. Location: Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Library, 150 E. San Fernando St., San Jose, CA 95112, Third Floor. Park for Free (first 90 minutes) at the Fourth Street Garage or take public transportations. Free program. No registrations required.

cases.refreshed: Screws are one of the simple machines that we use every day: they are used as hardware for building, but additionally, bottle caps, doorknobs, and standard light bulbs are also examples of screws. In this activity, patrons will create models of screws with different distances (ptich) between the inclined planes or ramps (threads) to find out which one will move a marble across a certain distance with less turns. Program is recommended for patrons 8-12. No registration required; first-come, first-served; capacities limited. At 3 p.m. we will distribute ten tickets; only participating children need a ticket.
